objective: Test whether a PRE-only adaptive mixture can generalize across a separately versioned learnable-regime Digital Twin whose hidden mechanism varies with ordinary PRE observables. Select one adaptive mapping on a synthetic design seed, freeze it, and evaluate once on a disjoint synthetic seed without retuning.

allowed: pre_mechanism_signal derived only from wind_speed_mps, num_lines, observed_score_standard_deviation

adaptive_family.formula: w_hat = sigmoid(bias + slope * pre_mechanism_signal); P_adapt=(1-w_hat)*P_C0 + w_hat*P_N1

design_eligibility: candidate overall mean ordered-top3 KL must be strictly lower than the best universal baseline overall KL
candidate KL in each nonempty LOW/MID/HIGH signal stratum must be <= 1.02 times the best universal baseline KL for that stratum
LOW and HIGH strata must each contain at least 40 races
winner_selection_order: lowest maximum stratum-relative-KL versus best universal baseline

design_outcome.zero_eligible: NO_DEVELOPMENT_ELIGIBLE_ADAPTIVE_MAPPING; do not access evaluation seed
design_outcome.positive_eligible: Freeze exactly one winner before evaluation scoring

evaluation_batch.access_rule: Only after exactly one design winner freezes

all_required: frozen adaptive overall mean ordered-top3 KL <= 0.98 times best universal baseline overall KL
frozen adaptive KL in every nonempty LOW/MID/HIGH stratum <= best universal baseline KL in that stratum
LOW and HIGH evaluation strata each contain at least 80 races

anti_overfit_boundary: No candidate-grid expansion after design outcomes.
No evaluation-seed access if design produces no eligible winner.
No hidden alpha or outcome in prediction inputs.
No real/historical input, RESULT/PAYOUT, odds, economics, ROI, bankroll, holdout, spend, or credentials.
Synthetic PASS cannot promote a real model or imply real-keirin calibration, edge, ROI, or profitability.
